arxiv-2102-00683.title: Non-SUSY Heterotic String Vacua of Gepner Models with Vanishing Cosmological Constant
arxiv-2102-00683.creator: Koji Aoyama
arxiv-2102-00683.description: Abstract We study a natural generalization of that given in [ 24 ] to heterotic string. Namely, starting from the generic Gepner models for Calabi-Yau 3-folds, we construct the non-SUSY heterotic string vacua with the vanishing cosmological constant at the one loop.

arxiv-2110-05595.description: Abstract We present a pilot library of synthetic NUV, U, B, V, and I photometry of star clusters with stochastically sampled IMFs and ionized gas for initial masses, M i = 10 3 M_{i}=10^{3} , 10 4 10^{4} , and 10 5 10^{5} M ⊙ M_{\odot} ; t = 1 t=1 , 3, 4, and 8 Myr; Z = 0.

arxiv-2111-14448.title: AVA-AVD: Audio-Visual Speaker Diarization in the Wild Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 10–14, 2022; Lisboa, Portugal Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’22), Oct. 10–14, 2022, Lisboa, Portugal DOI: 10.1145/350
arxiv-2111-14448.creator: Eric Zhongcong Xu, Zeyang Song, Satoshi Tsutsui, Chao Feng, Mang Ye, Mike Zheng Shou
arxiv-2111-14448.description: Abstract . Audio-visual speaker diarization aims at detecting “who spoke when” using both auditory and visual signals. Existing audio-visual diarization datasets are mainly focused on indoor environments like meeting rooms or news studios, which are quite different from in-the-wild videos in many scenarios such as movies, documentaries, and audience sitcoms.

arxiv-2205-06076.title: Aspects of univalence in holographic axion models
arxiv-2205-06076.creator: Matteo Baggioli, Sebastian Grieninger, Sašo Grozdanov, and Zhenkang Lu
arxiv-2205-06076.description: Abstract Univalent functions are complex, analytic (holomorphic) and injective functions that have been widely discussed in complex analysis. It was recently proposed that the stringent constraints that univalence imposes on the growth of functions combined with sufficient analyticity conditions could be used to derive rigorous lower and upper bounds on hydrodynamic dispersion relation, i.e.

arxiv-2211-08532.title: Omnidirectional robot modeling and simulation Thanks: This work is financed by National Funds through the Portuguese funding agency, FCT - Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia, within project UIDB/50014/2020, and the ERDF – European Regional Development Fund through the Operational Programme for C
arxiv-2211-08532.creator: Sandro A. Magalhães, António Paulo Moreira, Paulo Costa
arxiv-2211-08532.description: Abstract A robots simulation system is a basis need for any robotics application. With it, developers teams of robots can test their algorithms and make initial calibrations without risk of damage to the real robots, assuring safety. However, build these simulation environments is usually a time-consuming work, and when considering robot fleets, the simulation reveals to be computing expensive.

arxiv-2302-08458.title: Solid State Neuroscience: Spiking Neural Networks as Time Matter
arxiv-2302-08458.creator: Marcelo Rozenberg
arxiv-2302-08458.description: Abstract We aim at building a bridge between to a priori disconnected fields: Neuroscience and Material Science. We construct an analogy based on identifying spikes events in time with the positions of particles of matter. We show that one may think of the dynamical states of spiking neurons and spiking neural networks as time-matter .

arxiv-2311-09747.title: Stick-slip-to-stick transition of liquid oscillation in a U-tube
arxiv-2311-09747.creator: A. Bongarzone and F. Gallaire
arxiv-2311-09747.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Bongarzone and F. Gallaire. The nonlinear decay of oscillations of a liquid column in a U-shaped tube is investigated within the theoretical framework of the projection method formalized by Bongarzone et al. (2021) ( bongarzone2021relaxation ) . Starting from the full hydrodynamic system supplemented by a phenomenological contact line model, this physics-inspired method uses successive linear eigenmode projections to simulate the relaxation dynamics of liquid oscillations in the presence of sliding triple lines.

arxiv-2403-19018.title: Efficient global estimation of conditional-value-at-risk through stochastic kriging and extreme value theory
arxiv-2403-19018.creator: Armin Khayyer, Alexander Vinel, Joseph J. Kennedy
arxiv-2403-19018.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Armin Khayyer, Alexander Vinel, Joseph J. Kennedy. We consider the problem of evaluating risk for a system that is modeled by a complex stochastic simulation with many possible input parameter values. Two sources of computational burden can be identified: the effort associated with extensive simulation runs required to accurately represent the tail of the loss distribution for each set of parameter values, and the computational cost of evaluating multiple candidate parameter values.

arxiv-2406-14409.title: Measurement of the polarizations of prompt and non-prompt \JPsi and \PGy ​ ( 2 ​ S ) \PGy\mathrm{(2S)} mesons produced in \Pp ​ \Pp \Pp\Pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 \TeV
arxiv-2406-14409.description: Abstract The polarizations of prompt and non-prompt \JPsi and \PGy ​ ( 2 ​ S ) \PGy\mathrm{(2S)} mesons are measured in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 \TeV , using data samples collected by the CMS experiment in 2017 and 2018, corresponding to a total integrated luminosity of 103.3 \fbinv .

arxiv-2408-11264.title: Correlation Analysis of Adversarial Attack in Time Series Classification
arxiv-2408-11264.creator: Zhengyang Li, Wenhao Liang, Chang Dong, Weitong Chen, Dong Huang
arxiv-2408-11264.description: Abstract This study investigates the vulnerability of time series classification models to adversarial attacks, with a focus on how these models process local versus global information under such conditions. By leveraging the Normalized Auto Correlation Function (NACF), an exploration into the inclination of neural networks is conducted.

arxiv-2409-16398.title: shot noise in a phenomenological model of a marginal Fermi liquid
arxiv-2409-16398.creator: Yi-Ming Wu, Josephine J. Yu, S. Raghu
arxiv-2409-16398.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yi-Ming Wu, Josephine J. Yu, S. Raghu. The strange metal is a mysterious non-Fermi liquid which shows linear-in- T T resistivity behavior at finite temperatures, and, as found in recent experiment, vanishingly small shot noise in the linear-in- T T regime. Here, we investigate the shot noise of a strange metal based on a phenomenological model of marginal Fermi liquid (MFL), where fermions couple to some collective boson mode, leading to T T -linear scattering rate at finite T T .

arxiv-2505-08598.title: Grouptuner: Efficient Group-Aware Compiler Auto-tuning
arxiv-2505-08598.creator: Bingyu Gao, Mengyu Yao, Ziming Wang, Dong Liu, Ding Li, Xiangqun Chen, Yao Guo
arxiv-2505-08598.description: Abstract . Modern compilers typically provide hundreds of options to optimize program performance, but users often cannot fully leverage them due to the huge number of options. While standard optimization combinations (e.g., -O3 ) provide reasonable defaults, they often fail to deliver near-peak performance across diverse programs and architectures.

arxiv-2511-18963.title: A novel nonparametric framework for DIF detection using kernel-smoothed item response curves
arxiv-2511-18963.creator: Adéla Hladká, Patrícia Martinková
arxiv-2511-18963.description: Abstract This study introduces a novel nonparametric approach for detecting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) in binary items through direct comparison of Item Response Curves (IRCs). Building on prior work on nonparametric comparison of regression curves, we extend the methodology to accommodate binary response data, which is typical in psychometric applications.

arxiv-2511-21916.title: Energy-momentum tensor form factor 𝑫 ⁡ ( 𝒕 ) D(t) of proton and neutron
arxiv-2511-21916.creator: Andrea Mejia, Peter Schweitzer
arxiv-2511-21916.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrea Mejia, Peter Schweitzer. The energy-momentum tensor (EMT) form factor D ⁡ ( t ) D(t) is finite and negative in hadronic models and lattice QCD when only strong forces are included. However, when electromagnetic forces are considered, the D ⁡ ( t ) D(t) of charged hadrons undergoes a dramatic change: at small t t , it changes sign and diverges like 1 / − t 1/\sqrt{-t} as shown for the proton in the classical model by Białynicki-Birula based on residual nuclear forces

pmc-10722946.title: Mitigating Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Secondary to Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: Ameliorating Sexual Function and Psychological Well-Being in Older Men
pmc-10722946.creator: Alex Siu Wing Chan, Steve Wai Hee Chan, Anelise Gregis Estivalet, Lok Man Leung, Hon Lon Tam, Jacqueline Mei Chi Ho, Wing Leung Hsu, Patrick Ming Kuen Tang, Elsie Yan
pmc-10722946.description: This study aimed to investigate the prevalence of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) in older men (N= 3056) with benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and its effects on their sexual function and mental health. Descriptive, correlation, and regression analyses were used to explore the relationships between prostate and lower urinary tract health and psychological well-being.

pmc-11323478.title: Feline vector-borne haemopathogens in Türkiye: the first molecular detection of Mycoplasma wenyonii and ongoing Babesia ovis DNA presence in unspecific hosts
pmc-11323478.creator: Onur Ceylan, Zhuowei Ma, Ceylan Ceylan, Merve Ider, Ayşe Evci, Abdullah Mavinehir, Xuenan Xuan, Ferda Sevinc
pmc-11323478.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCats are hosts and reservoirs for many haemopathogens such as piroplasms, Rickettsia, hemotropic Mycoplasma, Bartonella, Ehrlichia, and Anaplasma, which are transmitted by various vector arthropods and some of which have a zoonotic concern. Although it is noteworthy that the rate of ownership of companion animals has increased in Türkiye in recent years and that cats account for a large proportion of these animals, there is limited research on the vector-borne infectious agents carried by them.

pmc-11674033.title: Use of the MNCD Classification to Monitor Clinical Stage and Response to Levodopa-Entacapone-Carbidopa Intestinal Gel Infusion in Advanced Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-11674033.creator: Diego Santos-García, Lydia López-Manzanares, Inés Muro, Pablo Lorenzo-Barreto, Elena Casas Peña, Rocío García-Ramos, Tamara Fernández Valle, Carlos Morata-Martínez, Raquel Baviera-Muñoz, Irene Martínez-Torres, María Álvarez-Sauco, Déborah Alonso-Modino, Inés Legarda, María Fuensanta Valero-García, J
pmc-11674033.description: Background and objective: Staging Parkinson’s disease (PD) with a novel simple classification called MNCD, based on four axes (Motor; Non-motor; Cognition; Dependency) and five stages, correlated with disease severity, patients’ quality of life and caregivers’ strain and burden. Our aim was to apply the MNCD classification in advanced PD patients treated with device-aided therapy (DAT).

pmc-11700312.title: Serotonin Levels and Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting in Cancer Patients: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11700312.creator: Damai Santosa, Alifiati Fitrikasari, Fenty Iswaningtyas, Novalia Kuntardjo, Kevin Tandarto, Titis Hadiati, Tanjung Ayu Sumekar, Widodo Sarjana, Natalia Dewi Wardani, Innawati Jusup
pmc-11700312.description: Introduction: Nausea and vomiting are distressing symptoms experienced by cancer patients undergoing treatment, impacting their physical well-being and quality of life. Serotonin, a neurotransmitter known for its role in regulating mood and gastrointestinal function, has been implicated in chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV).

pmc-12618447.title: Solving the QCD effective kinetic theory with neural networks
pmc-12618447.creator: S. Barrera Cabodevila, A. Kurkela, F. Lindenbauer
pmc-12618447.description: Event-by-event QCD kinetic theory simulations are hindered by the large numerical cost of evaluating the high-dimensional collision integral in the Boltzmann equation. In this work, we show that a neural network can be used to obtain an accurate estimate of the collision integral in a fraction of the time required for the ordinary Monte Carlo evaluation of the integral.

pmc-12649830.title: A Novel In Vitro Potency Assay Demonstrating the Anti-Fibrotic Mechanism of Action of CDCs in Deramiocel
pmc-12649830.creator: Yujia Li, Justin B Nice, Marya Kozinova, Stephanie Adachi, Linda Marbán, Kristi Elliott, Minghao Sun, Sung Il Im
pmc-12649830.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is characterized by progressive skeletal and cardiac muscle degeneration driven by inflammation and fibrosis, ultimately leading to cardiomyopathy and premature death. Deramiocel, an allogeneic cell therapy composed of cardiosphere-derived cells (CDCs), has demonstrated potent anti-fibrotic and immunomodulatory effects in preclinical models and clinical trials, including HOPE-2 and its open-label extension (HOPE-2 OLE), where Deramiocel treatment significantly attenuated progression of skeletal and cardiac muscle dysfunction.

pmc-13000719.title: Deletion of STIM1 in Treg cells protects against lung fibrosis and associated cardiovascular complications in a pre-clinical mouse model
pmc-13000719.creator: Nagaraja Nagre, Balaji Srinivas, Nicholas Richards, Ryan Washington, Gregory Nicholson, Yan Sanders, Beata Kosmider, Khalid Matrougui
pmc-13000719.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and incurable lung disease characterized by excessive tissue remodeling and impaired gas exchange. Evidence highlights the critical interplay between immune regulation, calcium signaling, and redox biology implications in the pathogenesis of fibrotic lung disease.

pmc-13077861.title: Upregulation of TRPV2 exacerbates age-related hearing loss by promoting oxidative stress in spiral ganglion neurons
pmc-13077861.creator: Zhidong Zhang, Huan Yin, Huan Cao, Miaomiao An, Yanan Li, Jianwang Yang, Tao Liu, Jiantao Wang, Lei Zhao, Chen Wang, Ruoxiang Miao, Baoshan Wang
pmc-13077861.description: Age-related hearing loss (ARHL) is a prevalent neurodegenerative condition characterized by the progressive loss of spiral ganglion neurons (SGNs). Although oxidative stress is recognized as a central pathogenic driver of ARHL, the precise molecular triggers that initiate and amplify SGN damage remain elusive. Here, we investigated the role of the Transient Receptor Potential Vanilloid 2 (TRPV2) channel in ARHL.

pmc-13356854.title: Bilateral Pulmonary Embolism Following Arthroscopic Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Case Report
pmc-13356854.creator: Ahmad Shakib Mohebi, Sayed Rahman Hakimi, Basira Bek, Sabawoon Mohebi, Nommanudien Naibkhil
pmc-13356854.description: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a serious complication associated with orthopedic surgery. It is well recognized in major procedures, such as total hip arthroplasty. However, there are few reports on the incidence of pulmonary embolism (PE) and its related risk factors following less invasive procedures, such as arthroscopic knee surgery.
